diagnosis: The endpoint downloads payroll and tax forms directly by document ID using Mongoose findById without checking if the document's employeeId matches req.user.employeeId. Any authenticated employee can enumerate document IDs to download W-2 and pay stub PDFs of other employees.
exploit_request:
GET /hr/payroll/65a3f18e90c8a12001e9d102/pdf HTTP/1.1
Host: hr.enterprise.internal
Authorization: Bearer <employee_jwt>
